newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Boat capsizes off Sabah, kills 14 Filipinos.
newsitem.headline: Boat capsizes off Sabah, kills 14 Filipinos.

text.p: Fourteen Filipinos drowned and three were missing after a boat trying to cross illegally into the east Malaysian state of Sabah capsized, police and witnesses said on Tuesday.
Twenty others on board the boat, which was carrying 37 Filipinos, were rescued.
"We're still looking for three missing people," Anuar Bashah Sohore, police chief in the town of Sandakan on the east coast of Sabah, told reporters.
The boat capsized on Monday evening in the Sulu Sea off Sandakan, which is about 240 km (150 miles) from the Sabah capital of Kota Kinabalu.
The bodies found so far included those of eight children and three women.
Sabah, Malaysia's nearest territory to the Philippines, has an army of illegal Filipino workers who have crossed into the state to fill an acute shortage of labour.
An estimated 500,000 foreign workers -- about half of them from the Philippines - - work in timber and oil-rich Sabah.
Malaysia has announced plans to use navy vessels to deport illegal workers.
